welcome_message:
🚀 Welcome to the QBR Demo Bundle Template!

This template creates a complete Databricks Asset Bundle with:
  • DLT Pipeline (Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion architecture)
  • Model Serving Endpoint
  • Lakeview Dashboard
  • Databricks App
  • Quality Monitors
  • Lakebase Database Instance

project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Project name must start with a letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores

catalog.description: Unity Catalog name for data assets

warehouse_id.description: SQL Warehouse ID for dashboards and apps

include_dlt_pipeline.description: Include DLT Pipeline for data ingestion?

owner_email.description: Email address for notifications and run_as in production

budget_policy_id.description: Budget policy ID for cost attribution (optional)

success_message:
✅ Bundle created successfully!

Next steps:
  1. cd {{.project_name}}
  2. Review and customize the generated files
  3. Run 'databricks bundle validate' to check configuration
  4. Run 'databricks bundle deploy -t dev' to deploy
